â”‚ through routing rules in your project's CLAUDE.md. Right now no CLAUDE.md exists here, so automatic routing isn't
â”‚ active. This is a one-time setup that benefits the whole team.

â”‚ Stakes if we pick wrong: Low â€” you can always add routing rules later or remove them. Without routing, you manually
â”‚ invoke skills; with routing, natural language triggers them.
